targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT a.id) AS "Applications" FROM inventory.applications a JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${application:sqlstring}='All' OR a.application_key=${application:sqlstring})
SELECT count(*) AS "Business Services" FROM inventory.business_services

SELECT count(DISTINCT ac.id) AS "Components" FROM inventory.application_components ac JOIN inventory.applications a ON a.id=ac.application_id JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${application:sqlstring}='All' OR a.application_key=${application:sqlstring})

SELECT count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.criticality='critical') AS "Critical Apps" FROM inventory.applications a JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${application:sqlstring}='All' OR a.application_key=${application:sqlstring})

SELECT count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status<>'active') AS "Attention" FROM inventory.applications a JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${application:sqlstring}='All' OR a.application_key=${application:sqlstring})

SELECT count(DISTINCT aps.site_id) AS "Hosting Sites" FROM inventory.application_sites aps JOIN inventory.applications a ON a.id=aps.application_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${application:sqlstring}='All' OR a.application_key=${application:sqlstring})

SELECT a.name AS "Application",a.application_key AS "Application Key",a.application_type AS "Type",initcap(a.environment) AS "Environment",initcap(a.criticality) AS "Criticality",initcap(a.status) AS "Status",count(DISTINCT ac.id) AS "Components",string_agg(DISTINCT s.name,', ' ORDER BY s.name) AS "Data Centers",o.name AS "Owner",a.version AS "Version",CASE WHEN a.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type",a.updated_at AS "Last Updated" FROM inventory.applications a JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id LEFT JOIN inventory.application_components ac ON ac.application_id=a.id LEFT JOIN inventory.owners o ON o.id=a.owner_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${application:sqlstring}='All' OR a.application_key=${application:sqlstring}) GROUP BY a.id,o.name ORDER BY CASE a.criticality WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,a.name

SELECT a.name AS "Application",ac.name AS "Component",ac.component_type AS "Type",ac.runtime AS "Runtime",ac.version AS "Version",initcap(ac.status) AS "Status",ac.listen_endpoints::text AS "Endpoints",CASE WHEN ac.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.application_components ac JOIN inventory.applications a ON a.id=ac.application_id JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${application:sqlstring}='All' OR a.application_key=${application:sqlstring}) ORDER BY a.name,ac.component_type,ac.name

SELECT bs.name AS "Business Service",initcap(bs.criticality) AS "Criticality",bs.service_tier AS "Tier",initcap(bs.status) AS "Status",o.name AS "Owner",bs.description AS "Description",CASE WHEN bs.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.business_services bs LEFT JOIN inventory.owners o ON o.id=bs.owner_id ORDER BY CASE bs.criticality WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,bs.name

list.label: Data Center
list.name: site
list.query: SELECT site_key AS __value,name AS __text FROM inventory.sites ORDER BY name

list.label: Application
list.name: application
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.application_key AS __value,a.name AS __text FROM inventory.applications a JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY a.name
